title: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 8: Wanyama wa porini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child tells a play by its names before each line and the directions in brackets, and reads each part in the voice of its speaker.

floor.prerequisite: Tells a story from a poem.
floor.question: Shairi lina beti?

representations: a short play with names in bold and directions in brackets

board.do: SIMBA: (kwa hasira) Nani amechukua chakula changu?

board.say: Maneno haya yanasemwa au yanaeleza jinsi ya kusema?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child reads Simba's line in an angry voice without reading the brackets aloud.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kipi kati ya hivi kinatoka kwenye mchezo wa kuigiza?" Kwa nini "Juma aliingia dukani na kusalimia." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Igizo huonyesha jina la mhusika, nukta mbili, kisha maneno anayosema. Hadithi huelezwa na msimulizi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni maelekezo ya jukwaani yapi?" Kwa nini "Hujambo, mzee?" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maelekezo ya jukwaani yako kwenye mabano. Yanamwonyesha muigizaji afanye nini, si aseme nini.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Nani alisema, "Nipe kilo mbili za unga"?" Kwa nini "Mzee Juma" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jina lililo mbele ya nukta mbili ndilo la mhusika anayesema mstari huo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Atieno alinunua nini dukani?" Kwa nini "sukari" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu la swali la igizo liko ndani ya igizo. Tafuta mstari unaolisema.

checks.question: Maneno yaliyo katika mabano ni nini?
